one_line: OpenAI closed $11 billion in funding, Anthropic pressed on with IPO plans, and market turmoil followed AI spending doubts.

themes.title: Funding rounds continue amid market rout
themes.text: OpenAI closed roughly $11 billion in new funding at a $1.25 trillion valuation, while Anthropic continued with IPO plans despite investor concerns. Meanwhile, Wall Street faced a $5.7 trillion market rout as reports showed AI spending flatlining and analysts warned the investment cycle may have peaked.

stories.headline: Anthropic presses on with November IPO plans despite global AI stock sell-off
OpenAI closes $11 billion in funding at $1.25 trillion valuation
Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
Wall Street grapples with $5.7 trillion rout as AI bets unwind
AI investment cycle may have peaked, Jefferies warns

themes.title: Backlash grows against data centers and agents
themes.text: Following U.S. midterm elections where voters passed 40 out of 41 ballot measures to restrict data centers, OpenAI changed its policies to end non-disclosure agreements with public officials. Additionally, a Delaware legislative proposal allowing AI agents to manage corporate entities drew criticism from Microsoft and lawmakers.

stories.headline: U.S. midterm elections bring voter backlash and new restrictions for AI data centers
OpenAI changes data center policies after midterm voter pushback
Delaware AI agent corporate proposal draws criticism from Microsoft and lawmakers

themes.title: Infrastructure shifts across tech giants
themes.text: Microsoft ended its Oracle AI cloud rental agreement due to obsolete Nvidia GPUs, while Google acquired a pre-developed Wyoming data center site from Crusoe. Google also purchased approximately 3 million shares of Qualcomm.

stories.headline: Microsoft ends Oracle AI cloud rental as older Nvidia GPUs become obsolete
Google spends $548 million to buy about 3 million Qualcomm shares
Google acquires southeast Wyoming data center site from Crusoe

themes.title: New AI research and model updates
themes.text: Physical Superintelligence announced that an internal AI research system running an Anthropic model produced a machine-checked proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture. Meta also introduced Active Memory and Active Focus updates for Muse and Meta AI.

stories.headline: Physical Superintelligence AI system proves Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture
Ethan Mollick shares Anthropic data on AI impact across scientific fields
Meta brings Active Memory and Active Focus to Muse and Meta AI
